Chris Gearing was a clear second to Woodford’s Emeka Udechuku in the A competition while yet another returnee from injury, Mark Allen, produced a pb to win the B shot.

All this made Woodford’s Emeka Udechuku’s winning distance even more impressive. Leith Marar improved on his match one distance but in a close battle he finished below target while Mark Allen, competing for the first time for Belgrave in the discus, was also a bit below par.

Emeka Udechuku won for WGwEL but their B man disappointed and we came out of this scrap a point ahead. And then another win in the 400 hurdles by Matt Douglas kept our points on target, backed by Chris Minn.
